study type: N/A - unclear from the abstract. Likely a case-control study.
outcome: CLBR (unclear from abstract, likely a marker of endometrial receptivity)
Inflammatory cytokines (IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-alpha, SDF-1alpha)
cohort: Women with Cesarean scar diverticula (CSD) and women with vaginal birth (VB) undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment.
finding: Women with Cesarean scar diverticula undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment had lower CLBR, exaggerated vascular proliferation and fibrosis, and increased inflammatory cytokines in the endometrium compared to women with vaginal birth, suggesting impaired fecundity potentially due to chronic inflammation and poor wound healing.
